t: You're looking at Saint George and the Dragon, a sculpture by Michael Sandle. Sandle is a British sculptor and artist whose public works often deal with war, death or destruction. The figure is Saint George, an early Christian martyr who, according to tradition, was a Roman soldier. He was sentenced to death for refusing to give up his faith. Since the Crusades he has been honoured especially as a military saint, so he suits a work with these themes.
